## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Spatial structures
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Uniform grid queries and Morton code ordering
//  - Kd-tree queries
//  - Derived functionality for spatial indexes and queries
//  - Hierarchy queries — BVHs, quadtrees and octrees

library SpatialStructures
{
    //==
    // # Uniform grid queries and Morton code ordering
    //
    // The `ISpatialIndex2D` / `ISpatialIndex3D` obligations of the four grids in
    // `spatial-structures.types.plato`, plus the ordering and digest the Morton codes
    // owe `IComparable` and `IHashable`.
    //
    // Both grid families store their buckets in CSR form, so a broad-phase query is
    // the same two steps in all four: test each cell's world bounds against the
    // query bounds, and concatenate the bucket slices of the cells that survive. The
    // result is conservative by construction — every item whose own extent reaches
    // into the query region was binned into a cell that overlaps it — and it carries
    // false positives, which is what the interface promises.

    //==
    // # SpatialHashGrid2D / 3D
    //
    // Sparse: only occupied cells exist, so the scan is over the stored cell
    // list rather than over the region. Cell (i, j) covers
    // [i * CellSize, (i+1) * CellSize) on each axis.

    // The world bounds of the i-th stored cell.
    CellBounds(self: SpatialHashGrid2D, i: Integer): Bounds2D {
        var c = self.CellCoordinates[i];
        var s = self.CellSize;
        return (Point2D(c.X.ToNumber * s, c.Y.ToNumber * s),
                Point2D((c.X + 1).ToNumber * s, (c.Y + 1).ToNumber * s));
    }

    // The i-th cell's bucket when it meets the query, and nothing when it does not.
    CellCandidates(self: SpatialHashGrid2D, bounds: Bounds2D, i: Integer): Array<ItemIndex>
        => self.CellBounds(i).Overlaps(bounds)
            ? self.ItemIndices.Slice(self.BucketOffsets[i], self.BucketOffsets[i + 1])
            : self.ItemIndices.Take(0);

    // Every item binned into a cell that meets the query bounds.
    CandidatesInBounds(self: SpatialHashGrid2D, bounds: Bounds2D): Array<ItemIndex>
        => self.CellCoordinates.Count.Range.FlatMap(i => self.CellCandidates(bounds, i));

    // Every binned item, counted once per cell it was binned into.
    ItemCount(self: SpatialHashGrid2D): Integer
        => self.ItemIndices.Count;

    // The world bounds of the i-th stored cell.
    CellBounds(self: SpatialHashGrid3D, i: Integer): Bounds3D {
        var c = self.CellCoordinates[i];
        var s = self.CellSize;
        return (Point3D(c.X.ToNumber * s, c.Y.ToNumber * s, c.Z.ToNumber * s),
                Point3D((c.X + 1).ToNumber * s, (c.Y + 1).ToNumber * s, (c.Z + 1).ToNumber * s));
    }

    // The i-th cell's bucket when it meets the query, and nothing when it does not.
    CellCandidates(self: SpatialHashGrid3D, bounds: Bounds3D, i: Integer): Array<ItemIndex>
        => self.CellBounds(i).Overlaps(bounds)
            ? self.ItemIndices.Slice(self.BucketOffsets[i], self.BucketOffsets[i + 1])
            : self.ItemIndices.Take(0);

    // Every item binned into a cell that meets the query bounds.
    CandidatesInBounds(self: SpatialHashGrid3D, bounds: Bounds3D): Array<ItemIndex>
        => self.CellCoordinates.Count.Range.FlatMap(i => self.CellCandidates(bounds, i));

    // Every binned item, counted once per cell it was binned into.
    ItemCount(self: SpatialHashGrid3D): Integer
        => self.ItemIndices.Count;

    //==
    // # BinningGrid2D / 3D
    //
    // Dense: every cell of the region has a bucket, so the scan is over the
    // bucket count, which the CSR offsets carry (one more entry than buckets).
    // Bucket b delinearizes with X varying fastest.

    // The number of buckets, read off the CSR offset array.
    BucketCount(self: BinningGrid2D): Integer
        => self.BucketOffsets.Count - 1;

    // The world bounds of bucket b.
    BucketBounds(self: BinningGrid2D, b: Integer): Bounds2D {
        var min = self.Bounds.Min;
        var max = self.Bounds.Max;
        var columns = self.CellCounts.Width;
        var i = b % columns;
        var j = b / columns;
        var dx = (max.X - min.X) / columns.ToNumber;
        var dy = (max.Y - min.Y) / self.CellCounts.Height.ToNumber;
        return (Point2D(min.X + i.ToNumber * dx, min.Y + j.ToNumber * dy),
                Point2D(min.X + (i + 1).ToNumber * dx, min.Y + (j + 1).ToNumber * dy));
    }

    // Bucket b's items when its cell meets the query, and nothing when it does not.
    BucketCandidates(self: BinningGrid2D, bounds: Bounds2D, b: Integer): Array<ItemIndex>
        => self.BucketBounds(b).Overlaps(bounds)
            ? self.ItemIndices.Slice(self.BucketOffsets[b], self.BucketOffsets[b + 1])
            : self.ItemIndices.Take(0);

    // Every item binned into a cell that meets the query bounds.
    CandidatesInBounds(self: BinningGrid2D, bounds: Bounds2D): Array<ItemIndex>
        => self.BucketCount.Range.FlatMap(b => self.BucketCandidates(bounds, b));

    // Every binned item, counted once per cell it was binned into.
    ItemCount(self: BinningGrid2D): Integer
        => self.ItemIndices.Count;

    // The number of buckets, read off the CSR offset array.
    BucketCount(self: BinningGrid3D): Integer
        => self.BucketOffsets.Count - 1;

    // The world bounds of bucket b.
    BucketBounds(self: BinningGrid3D, b: Integer): Bounds3D {
        var min = self.Bounds.Min;
        var max = self.Bounds.Max;
        var columns = self.CellCounts.Width;
        var rows = self.CellCounts.Height;
        var i = b % columns;
        var j = b / columns % rows;
        var k = b / (columns * rows);
        var dx = (max.X - min.X) / columns.ToNumber;
        var dy = (max.Y - min.Y) / rows.ToNumber;
        var dz = (max.Z - min.Z) / self.CellCounts.Depth.ToNumber;
        return (Point3D(min.X + i.ToNumber * dx, min.Y + j.ToNumber * dy, min.Z + k.ToNumber * dz),
                Point3D(min.X + (i + 1).ToNumber * dx,
                        min.Y + (j + 1).ToNumber * dy,
                        min.Z + (k + 1).ToNumber * dz));
    }

    // Bucket b's items when its cell meets the query, and nothing when it does not.
    BucketCandidates(self: BinningGrid3D, bounds: Bounds3D, b: Integer): Array<ItemIndex>
        => self.BucketBounds(b).Overlaps(bounds)
            ? self.ItemIndices.Slice(self.BucketOffsets[b], self.BucketOffsets[b + 1])
            : self.ItemIndices.Take(0);

    // Every item binned into a cell that meets the query bounds.
    CandidatesInBounds(self: BinningGrid3D, bounds: Bounds3D): Array<ItemIndex>
        => self.BucketCount.Range.FlatMap(b => self.BucketCandidates(bounds, b));

    // Every binned item, counted once per cell it was binned into.
    ItemCount(self: BinningGrid3D): Integer
        => self.ItemIndices.Count;

    //==
    // # Morton codes
    //
    // The whole point of a Z-order code is that the natural order of the codes
    // is a spatial order, so `IComparable` and `IHashable` both go straight to the
    // carrier integer.

    // Codes order as their carrier integers do — which is the Z-order.
    LessThanOrEquals(a: MortonCode2D, b: MortonCode2D): Boolean
        => a.Value <= b.Value;
```
